cards.title: An independent runtime per channel
items: process X holds an auth Client and a report Client, making an independent runtime per channel that manages the auth connection and report connection separately.
auth and report don't share connection targets or lifetimes. Even when the same process Z takes part in both channels (Z1·Z2), each channel runtime manages its connection to Z separately.
